name: fivem-server-builder
description: Mercy Launcher — a centralized game-management hub, starting with a full FiveM server-management ecosystem

scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev:main" "npm run dev:renderer"
scripts.dev:main: npx tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && node scripts/copy-assets.js && npx electron .
scripts.build: npx tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && npx vite build && node scripts/copy-assets.js
scripts.test:vs: npx tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && node test/vehicle-studio/meta.test.js && node test/vehicle-studio/service.test.js
scripts.test:minecraft: npx tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && node test/minecraft/service.test.js && node test/minecraft/java-runtime.test.js && node test/minecraft/marketplace.test.js && node test/minecraft/connection.test.js && node test/minecraft/bedrock.test.js && node test/minecraft/import-smoke.test.js && node test/minecraft/port-sync.test.js && node test/minecraft/worlds-and-packs.test.js && node test/minecraft/bedrock-marketplace.test.js && node test/minecraft/content-center.test.js
scripts.test:assettocorsa: npx tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && node test/assettocorsa/service.test.js && node test/assettocorsa/runtime.test.js
scripts.test:theme: npx tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && node test/theme/manager.test.js && node test/theme/presets.test.js
scripts.test:games: npx tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && node test/gamescanner/service.test.js && node test/gamescanner/classification.test.js && node test/gamescanner/manual-games.test.js
scripts.test:access: npx tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && node test/access/service.test.js && node test/vehicle-studio/auth.test.js
scripts.test:presence: npx tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && node test/presence/service.test.js && node test/presence/friends-logic.test.js && node test/presence/approveJoinAuthToken.test.js
scripts.test:connection: npx tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && node test/connection/upnp.test.js && node test/connection/tunnelProxy.test.js && node test/connection/relaySignalingClient.test.js && node test/connection/relayDataChannel.test.js && node test/connection/relayConnectionManager.test.js && node test/connection/connectionNegotiator.test.js && node test/connection/envConfig.test.js && node test/connection/mainRelayHostToken.test.js
scripts.test:all: npm run test:vs && node test/minecraft/service.test.js && node test/minecraft/java-runtime.test.js && node test/minecraft/marketplace.test.js && node test/minecraft/connection.test.js && node test/minecraft/bedrock.test.js && node test/minecraft/import-smoke.test.js && node test/minecraft/port-sync.test.js && node test/minecraft/worlds-and-packs.test.js && node test/minecraft/bedrock-marketplace.test.js && node test/minecraft/content-center.test.js && node test/assettocorsa/service.test.js && node test/assettocorsa/runtime.test.js && node test/theme/manager.test.js && node test/theme/presets.test.js && node test/gamescanner/service.test.js && node test/gamescanner/classification.test.js && node test/gamescanner/manual-games.test.js && node test/access/service.test.js && node test/vehicle-studio/auth.test.js && node test/library/ui-structure.test.js && node test/presence/service.test.js && node test/presence/friends-logic.test.js && node test/presence/approveJoinAuthToken.test.js && node test/connection/upnp.test.js && node test/connection/tunnelProxy.test.js && node test/connection/relaySignalingClient.test.js && node test/connection/relayDataChannel.test.js && node test/connection/relayConnectionManager.test.js && node test/connection/connectionNegotiator.test.js && node test/connection/envConfig.test.js && node test/connection/mainRelayHostToken.test.js && node test/fivem/marketplace.test.js && npx electron test/updater/quit-and-install-guard.test.js
scripts.build:exe: npm run build && npx electron-builder --win --dir --publish never && node scripts/patch-windows-exe.js && npx electron-builder --win --prepackaged releases/win-unpacked --publish never
scripts.electron:dev: npx concurrently -k "npx vite" "npx tsc -p tsconfig.main.json -w" "npx wait-on http://localhost:5173 && node scripts/copy-assets.js && npx electron ."
